cubes.text: The museum’s cool air wraps around you as you step inside, and almost immediately a familiar figure hurries toward you with a bright, eager smile.

There you are! I was hoping you’d stop by. I wanted to thank you properly—for the donations and especially for the idea of accepting them in the first place. It’s working. Donations keep growing, and the mini cinema has become a steady stream of income. People have been donating old film collections from their attics, and we’ve even bought a few new ones at bargain prices.

Honestly, you’re the one who did all the work. I just threw an idea into the air. I’m glad my small contributions help the place get better. And, well… seeing you smile like that is a pretty good bonus.
Okay, now you’re definitely making me blush, hehe. But thank you. Really. I have to get back to the pile of paperwork waiting for me. Come by more often—we’ve got some new films you might like.
She returns to her station behind a cluttered desk and laptop, pausing once more to give you a soft, warm smile before her attention shifts to the screen, and she’s back to work.
